about:
Binds keybinds to macros. Saved by spec.

Allows you to do all your binds in a single panel.

![BindPanel](https://i.imgur.com/lcPQrMf.png)

releases.name: BindPanel 1.0.10
releases.notes:
▪ Fixed errors from the spec menu tooltip on Classic.
▪ Added support for WoW Forever.

releases.name: BindPanel 1.0.8
releases.notes:
▪ Fixed spec detection in Vanilla/TBC.
▪ Fixed leaked global.

releases.name: BindPanel 1.0.7
releases.notes:
▪ Added support for the 2 possible values of the _ActionButtonUseKeyDown_ CVar.
▪ Added support for the Evoker's "Hold and Release" empowered spell input.
▪ TOC update.

releases.name: BindPanel 1.0.5
releases.notes:
▪ Fixed detection of vehicles (wasn't detecting all) for the remapping of binds to vehicle buttons while in a vehicle.
▪ TOC update.
